script_text: Pisces, the heavens are aligning to thrust you into a pivotal week of transformation. On Monday, Neptune, your ruler, trines Venus in your 5th House, sparking romance and creativity. Tuesday brings a Mars square to your natal Moon from your 10th House, stirring career pressure and emotional tension. The celestial alignment will bring clarity, inspiration, and unexpected opportunities, guiding your journey toward lasting fulfillment and joy in every aspect. Mid‑week, Mercury retrogrades in your 9th House, prompting a review of beliefs. Thursday sees the Sun enter your 6th House, energizing daily routines. The weekend features a Saturn trine to Neptune in your 12th House, fostering spiritual clarity. Your power day is Wednesday, when Venus enters your 5th House, amplifying love. The most challenging day is Tuesday, as Mars squares your Moon, causing turbulence. Ground your watery dreams in concrete career actions. Follow for daily updates.
